page_data.en:
Special Branch, S.2.
October 27, 1933.

Communist Propaganda

The following communist propaganda came into the
possession of the Municipal Police on October 26 :-
1) Circular dated October 13, 1933, issued by the
Kiangsu Provincial Committee of the Communist Youth
League, deals at great length with a resolution passed
by the aforementioned committee calling for the
resignation of the Secretary-General of the Kiangsu
Provincial Committee on the grounds that he has
neglected his work and has been guilty of general
slackness in his management of Party affairs. The
circular goes on to state that the Secretary-General
ignored the secret orders of the Provincial Committee
and in so-doing endangered the personal safety of the
committee members.
2) Circular dated October 12, 1933, issued by the
Propaganda Department of the Kiangsu Provincial
Committee of the Communist Youth League contains
a number of resolutions opposing the 5th Anti-Red
Offensive launched by the Kuomintang and calls upon
all comrades to intensify the campaign among the
young workers of the country in order to safeguard
them from the attack.
3) A handwritten poster bearing the heading "Resistance -
N.W.K. No.1 and 2 Mills," appeals to workers of the
N.W.K. Mills to declare a strike in order to oppose
the dismissal of certain workers and also to demand
an increase in pay.
page_data.zh:
特别分部，S.2。
1933年10月27日。

共产主义宣传品

下列共产主义宣传品于10月26日落入工部局警务处手中：
1) 日期为1933年10月13日的传单，由共产主义青年团江苏省委发出，详细论述了上述委员会通过的一项决议，要求江苏省委书记辞职，理由是其工作疏忽，且在管理党务方面普遍存在懈怠行为。该传单接着指出，书记无视省委的秘密指令，此举危及了委员会成员的人身安全。
2) 日期为1933年10月12日的传单，由共产主义青年团江苏省委宣传部发出，包含多项反对国民党发动的第五次“围剿”红军行动的决议，并号召全体同志加强在全国青年工人中的运动，以保护他们免受攻击。
3) 一份手写海报，标题为“抵制——西北纺织厂第一、二厂”，呼吁西北纺织厂的工人举行罢工，以反对解雇某些工人，并要求增加工资。

POLICE FORCE.
MUNICIPAL COUNCIL.
Shanghai, October 3, 1933
To Officer i/c Special Branch

Sir,

With reference to the endorsement
of the Officer i/c Special Branch on
the attached report dated 2.10.33, I
have to state that the information
concerning the meeting of communist
suspects held in Western District on
30.9.33 was furnished by Agent
A-2315.

SBL 3/10
Kuh Tao-hwa
D. I.
Reg. Reference "A",
Please attach Off
in attached forwarding
letter.

上海，1933年10月3日
致：特别分部主管警官

先生，

关于特别分部主管警官在附件中1933年10月2日报告上的签注，本人须说明，有关1933年9月30日在西区举行的共产主义嫌疑分子会议的情报，系由探员 A-2315 提供。

SBL 10月3日
顾道华
督察

请附在随附的转呈信中。
